title: GraphQL API Testing: Companion Tests
author: Mathias Paulenko
description: Runnable Jest + supertest tests for the GraphQL API Testing guide: query and mutation lifecycle, error contract assertions, APQ persisted queries, a graphql-ws subscription test and a schema-diff CI script.
